# LIP-v1 Audit Checklists — Per-Aggregate Conformity

**Purpose:** Pre-audit validation rules for every file generated by the Implementation Generator (IGS-v1). Each checklist maps to one of the 13 Lumina aggregates.
**Version:** 1.0
**Date:** 2026-07-26
**Source of Truth:** DOC-000 through DOC-024, IGS-v1, ARA-v1

## GENERAL AUDIT RULES (Apply to ALL Aggregates)

These rules apply universally. Check each before aggregate-specific rules.

- [ ] Module NestJS respects the module boundary structure (`domains/{aggregate}/`)
- [ ] ALL imports from `infrastructure/` are resolved exclusively via Port Interfaces (Dependency Inversion Principle per DOC-000 Rule 4 + DOC-004 PONT 12)
- [ ] ALL domain entities have `id: UUID PRIMARY KEY`
- [ ] ALL domain entities have `org_id: uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- [ ] ALL domain entities have `created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()`
- [ ] ALL domain entities have `updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()` with `update_updated_at_column()` trigger
- [ ] ALL code references `_org_id` consistently per DOC-023 §8 (multi-tenant isolation)
- [ ] NO hardcoded hex colors (design-token driven per ITS-v1 NB-TECH-009)
- [ ] NO `console.log` / `console.error` (NestJS `Logger` only)
- [ ] NO `@ts-ignore`
- [ ] NO `any` type (per ITS-v1 NB-TECH-002 strict mode)
- [ ] Domain events implement `DomainEvent` interface with `aggregateId`, `eventType`, `timestamp`
- [ ] Application services expose typed interfaces (ASS-001 pattern)
- [ ] Adapters implement ports defined in PAS-001
- [ ] Prisma models correspond to `POSTGRESQL-SCHEMA-PACK-v1.md` for each table
- [ ] Audit entries logged via `AuditAggregate.LogAction()` after every state change (DOC-012 §10, BR-AUD-001)
- [ ] No business rules invented — all guards trace back to DOC-012 or DOC-015
- [ ] Generated artifact contains IGS-v1 metadata headers: `generation_id`, `source_canonical`, `transformation_rule`, `architecture_version`, `compliance_status` (IGS-v1 §5.1)

## Aggregate 1: OrganizationAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §1 |
| **Capability** | Identity, Relationship, Branding, Configuration |
| **Boundary** | Org identity, recursive hierarchy (<=5 levels), units, global config |
| **Owner** | Superadmin (creates org), Org admin (manages units/settings) |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `OrganizationModule` exists at `domains/organization/organization.module.ts`
- [ ] `OrganizationService` implements organization application service interface
- [ ] `OrgUnitModule` co-located within organization aggregate
- [ ] Port interface `IOrganizationRepository` defined in `domains/organization/ports/`
- [ ] Adapter (Prisma) in `infrastructure/adapters/organization/prisma-organization.adapter.ts` implements `IOrganizationRepository`
- [ ] Organization port used by other aggregates, never reverse-dependency

### Invariants Validation (NB-PERSIST / DOC-023)
- [ ] Depth <= 5 enforced at domain layer BEFORE reaching persistence (DOC-023 §3.4 Contraintes de Profondeur)
- [ ] Cycle detection via topological sort on `OrgUnit` parent changes (BR-ORG-003 + BR-REL-001)
- [ ] `org_id` injected into ALL queries (BR-ORG-004)
- [ ] Merged organizations require superadmin validation (BR-ORG-005)
- [ ] Suspended organizations allow read-only access only (BR-ORG-006)
- [ ] Status transitions: `inactive -> active -> suspended -> archived` (irreversible from archived)

### Commands Mapped
- [ ] `CreateOrganization`
- [ ] `UpdateOrganizationSettings`
- [ ] `CreateOrgUnit`
- [ ] `UpdateOrgUnitParent`
- [ ] `TransferOrgUnit`
- [ ] `ArchiveOrganization`
- [ ] `SuspendOrganization`
- [ ] `MergeOrganizations`

### Domain Events
- [ ] `OrganizationCreated`
- [ ] `OrganizationSuspended`
- [ ] `OrganizationArchived`
- [ ] `OrgUnitCreated`
- [ ] `OrgUnitParentChanged`
- [ ] `OrgMerged`

### Database Mapping
- [ ] `organizations` table matches `POSTGRESQL-SCHEMA-PACK-v1.md` columns exactly
- [ ] `org_units` table with self-referencing `parent_id` FK
- [ ] `organization_settings` JSONB inline VO storage
- [ ] Composite unique constraint on `(name)` for global uniqueness

## Aggregate 2: IdentityAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §2 |
| **Capability** | Identity, Permission, Audit |
| **Boundary** | Unique user identity, credentials, sessions, permissions |
| **Owner** | Superadmin, Admin |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `IdentityModule` at `domains/identity/identity.module.ts`
- [ ] `UserService` implements identity application service interface
- [ ] `SessionService` handles session lifecycle
- [ ] Port interfaces: `IUserRepository`, `ISessionRepository`, `ICredentialRepository`
- [ ] Adapters implement all port interfaces

### Invariants Validation
- [ ] `passwordHash` never stored plaintext, never in logs (BR-ID-001)
- [ ] JWT stored encrypted (expo-secure-store on client, never plain text server-side) (BR-ID-002)
- [ ] Email unique per org via composite constraint `(org_id, email)` (BR-ID-003)
- [ ] Superadmin can create ALL users; Admin limited to treasurer/pastor/staff (not superadmin) (BR-ID-004, BR-ID-005)
- [ ] Wildcard permissions `[\"*\"]` audited but allowed (BR-ID-006)
- [ ] Password complexity validated against Policy (PasswordValidator domain service)
- [ ] Session transitions: `active -> expired -> revoked`

### Role Enum Enforcement
- [ ] UserRole values strictly: `superadmin`, `admin`, `treasurer`, `pastor`, `staff`
- [ ] CHECK constraint: `role_utilisateur IN (...)`

### Domain Events
- [ ] `UserCreated`, `UserUpdated`, `UserRoleChanged`
- [ ] `PasswordResetRequested`, `UserLoggedIn`, `UserLoggedOut`
- [ ] `SessionCreated`, `SessionExpired`, `SessionRevoked`

### Security Audit
- [ ] `credentials` table has `UNIQUE(user_id)` (1:1 composition)
- [ ] `sessions` table stores `refresh_token_hash` (NOT raw token)
- [ ] Password hash NEVER appears in `old_values` or `new_values` of audit entries (SEC-SPEC-004 §8)
- [ ] Token memory is volatile — never persisted, never returned in API responses (SEC-SPEC-005 §3.3)

## Aggregate 3: ResourceAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §3 |
| **Capability** | Resource, Lifecycle, Policy, Search, Audit, Reporting, Offline Sync |
| **Boundary** | CRUD generic for any manipulable resource, state + versioning |
| **Owner** | Role-based via `resource:*:read/write` permission grant |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `ResourceModule` at `domains/resource/resource.module.ts`
- [ ] Transaction, Member, Event, ArchiveEntry as typed resource subtypes
- [ ] Port: `IResourceRepository` with generic resource CRUD
- [ ] Domain Services: `ResourceFactory`, `ResourceValidator`, `ResourceScopeResolver`

### Invariants Validation
- [ ] Amount always positive (`CHECK amount > 0`) (BR-RES-001)
- [ ] Approved transactions NEVER modified — corrections via `compensates_for` (INV-001) (BR-RES-002)
- [ ] Every resource has version field incremented on every change (INV-010) (BR-RES-003)
- [ ] Date never in the future (BR-RES-004)
- [ ] Scope type must be `'org'` or `'group'` (mandatory for transactions) (BR-RES-005)
- [ ] Category reference always from Vocabulary (INV-006) (BR-RES-006)
- [ ] `created_by` always set (BR-RES-007)
- [ ] Amount stored as BIGINT cents (never float) (BR-RES-008)

### State Machines
- [ ] Transaction: `draft -> pending -> approved / rejected`
- [ ] Member: `active -> inactive / deceased / transferred`
- [ ] Event: `draft -> published / cancelled / completed`
- [ ] ArchiveEntry: `draft -> active -> archived -> trashed -> purged`

### Domain Events
- [ ] `ResourceCreated`, `ResourceUpdated`, `ResourceStateChanged`, `ResourceDeleted`
- [ ] `TransactionCompensated`, `ApprovalRequested`, `ApprovalGranted`, `ApprovalRejected`

### Polymorphic References
- [ ] `resource_type` + `resource_id` stored together for polymorphic refs (DOC-023 §3.5)
- [ ] Entity type enumerated: `transaction`, `member`, `event`, `archive_entry`

- [ ] `groupe_id` FK references `org_units(id)` ON DELETE RESTRICT

## Aggregate 5: WorkflowAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §5 |
| **Capability** | Workflow, Notification, Policy, Audit |
| **Boundary** | Workflow definitions, executions, steps, timeouts, escalations |
| **Owner** | System (auto-triggered) or Admin (manual) |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `WorkflowModule` at `domains/workflow/workflow.module.ts`
- [ ] `WorkflowInstance` entity with `currentStepIndex`, `totalSteps`, `status`
- [ ] `WorkflowStep` entity with `type` (auto/approval/notification/conditional/delay/parallel)

### Invariants Validation
- [ ] Timeout max 30 days (BR-WF-001) — `CHECK timeout_jours BETWEEN 1 AND 30`
- [ ] Approval chain max 5 hierarchical levels (BR-WF-002)

- [ ] All execution states logged to audit trail (INV-007) (BR-WF-004)

- [ ] Workflows cannot create new capabilities or add to manifest (BR-WF-006)

### State Machines
- [ ] `WorkflowInstance`: `running -> completed / failed / cancelled`
- [ ] `WorkflowStep`: `pending -> in_progress -> completed / failed / skipped`

### Domain Events
- [ ] `WorkflowTriggered`, `StepExecuted`, `StepApproved`, `StepRejected`, `StepEscalated`
- [ ] `WorkflowCompleted`, `WorkflowFailed`, `WorkflowCancelled`

## Aggregate 10: AuditAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §10 |
| **Capability** | Audit |
| **Boundary** | Immutable journal of ALL user actions: who, what, when, old_value, new_value |
| **Owner** | Immutable system-owned aggregate |

### CRITICAL RULES — These are NeverBreak violations if breached
- [ ] ONLY AuditAggregate uses append-only immutable log pattern (NB-PERSIST-006) (DOC-023 §9.1 NB-RR-007)
- [ ] DELETE never called on audit entries during retention period (NB-PERSIST-006)
- [ ] UPDATE never called on audit entries during retention period
- [ ] AuditAggregate does NOT audit itself (NB-PERSIST-007 — no feedback loop) (NB-RR-008)
- [ ] Both `old_values` AND `new_values` ALWAYS captured (FullSnapshotPolicy) (BR-AUD-002)
- [ ] Logs retained minimum 7 years (configurable via Policy) (BR-AUD-003)
- [ ] Impossible to modify or delete any log entry (BR-AUD-004)
- [ ] Access restricted to admins and auditors only via RBAC (BR-AUD-005)
- [ ] Manifest changes also logged: `audit.log_manifest_changes: true` (BR-AUD-006)

### Action Type Enum
- [ ] Strictly: `create`, `update`, `delete`, `approve`, `reject`, `transfer`, `notify`, `other`

### Polymorphic Reference
- [ ] `entity_type` + `entity_id` stored together (DOC-023 §3.5)
- [ ] Links to any other Aggregate — AuditAggregate receives write requests, does not initiate them (DOC-023 §6.1)

## Aggregate 11: LifecycleAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §11 |
| **Capability** | Lifecycle, Policy, Search, Resource |
| **Boundary** | Configurable states for ANY resource: draft -> active -> archived -> trashed -> purged |
| **Owner** | System (enforces rules) + Admin (configures via manifest) |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `LifecycleModule` at `domains/lifecycle/lifecycle.module.ts`
- [ ] `ArchiveEntry` entity with lifecycle state tracking
- [ ] `LifecycleTypeDefinition` (archivable_types declared in manifest)
- [ ] Domain Services: `StateTransitionValidator`, `PurgeScheduler`

### Invariants Validation
- [ ] States configurable per org via `manifest.lifecycle.types[]` (BR-LIF-001)
- [ ] Archive linked to original resource (`resource_type` + `resource_id`) (BR-LIF-002)
- [ ] Optional linking to members (`linked_member_id` FK) (BR-LIF-003)
- [ ] Tags + categories for flexible organization (BR-LIF-004)
- [ ] Purge date configurable per archivable type (BR-LIF-005)
- [ ] Trashed entries NOT visible in normal queries, only via archive search (BR-LIF-006)
- [ ] Purge is irreversible — once purged, cannot restore (INV LIF-003)

### State Machine
- [ ] `active -> archived -> trashed -> purged`
- [ ] `trashed -> active` (restore, reversible)
- [ ] `archived -> active` (reopen, reversible)
- [ ] `purged -> ANY` (forbidden, irreversible)

### Soft Delete Pattern
- [ ] `_tombstone = true` for logically deleted objects (DOC-023 §7.1)
- [ ] Normal queries exclude `_tombstone = true` records (DOC-023 §7.1)
- [ ] Sync queries INCLUDE tombstoned records to propagate deletions (DOC-023 §7.1)

## Aggregate 13: OfflineSyncAggregate

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Doc ID** | DOC-012 §13 |
| **Capability** | Offline Sync |
| **Boundary** | Bidirectional sync: local SQLite <-> remote PostgreSQL |
| **Owner** | System-owned (automatic, user-transparent) |

### Entities & Code Structure
- [ ] `OfflineSyncModule` at `domains/offline-sync/offline-sync.module.ts`
- [ ] `PendingOperation` entity (resource_type, resource_id, action, payload, sync_status)
- [ ] `SyncStatusTracker` entity (last_sync_timestamp per table, connection_state)
- [ ] Domain Services: `PushCoordinator`, `PullCoordinator`, `ConflictResolver`

### Invariants Validation
- [ ] Local write ALWAYS precedes remote write (INV-003: offline-absolute) (BR-SYNC-001)
- [ ] Approved transactions = immutable, no sync override (BR-SYNC-002)
- [ ] Draft transactions = UUID dedup + side-by-side diff (BR-SYNC-003)
- [ ] Members/Events = LWW (Last Write Wins by timestamp) (BR-SYNC-004)
- [ ] Categories = server-wins (lookup table) (BR-SYNC-005)
- [ ] Batch size max 50 operations, retry exponential backoff max 5 attempts (BR-SYNC-006)
- [ ] No user operation depends on synchronous API call (BR-SYNC-007)

### Conflict Resolution Matrix (per entity type)
- [ ] Approved transactions: `immutable` (server-wins, no modification)
- [ ] Draft transactions: `uuid_dedup` + `side_by_side` (keep both)
- [ ] Members/Events: `LWW` (last write wins by timestamp)
- [ ] Categories: `server_wins` (lookup table authoritative)
- [ ] PendingOperations: `create` -> `sent` -> `confirmed / failed` -> `pending` (retry)

### Retry Backoff Schedule
- [ ] Exponential: 1000ms -> 2000ms -> 4000ms -> 8000ms -> 16000ms (max 5 attempts)

### Domain Events
- [ ] `SyncStarted`, `BatchPushed`, `DeltaReceived`, `ConflictDetected`, `ConflictResolved`
- [ ] `SyncCompleted`, `ConnectionLost`, `ConnectionRestored`
